articles.title: Paul Pelosi in Another Car Incident: Hit-and-Run in California Wine Country
articles.summary: Paul Pelosi, 86, hit a parked car in Yountville and drove off. No injuries, but he could face misdemeanor charges. He had no alcohol in his system.

articles.title: Khamenei's Funeral: A Spectacle of Symbolism and Political Messaging
articles.summary: Iran's late Supreme Leader Khamenei's funeral uses religious symbols like a clenched fist and red flags to call for unity and revenge against the US and Israel.
